title: EO 14365 - Ensuring a National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence
claims: EO 14365 signed December 11, 2025; policy of a minimally burdensome national AI framework to preempt 50-state patchwork
Sec. 3: Attorney General to establish an AI Litigation Task Force within 30 days to challenge inconsistent State AI laws
Sec. 4: Commerce to evaluate State AI laws within 90 days (esp. laws forcing models to alter truthful outputs)
Sec. 5: States with onerous AI laws made ineligible for non-deployment BEAD funds; discretionary grants conditionable
Sec. 6: FCC proceeding on a Federal reporting/disclosure standard preempting State laws
Sec. 7: FTC policy statement on preemption of State laws requiring alterations to truthful model outputs
Sec. 8: legislative recommendation for uniform Federal framework; carve-outs for child safety, data center infrastructure, State procurement
draft_usage: Cited for the December 2025 state-preemption executive order under Social (US policy).
